title: Financial Context-Rich Strategy for Actor-Critic based Agents: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Stock Trading
title_zh: 面向基于 Actor-Critic 智能体的金融上下文丰富策略：一种用于股票交易的深度强化学习方法

paragraphs.en: In modern financial markets, more than 3 / 4 t ​ h {{3}/{4}}^{th} of the large volume trade is executed by algorithmic trading based on advanced trading strategies to attain higher precision and speed than traditional human traders. The conventional strategies focused on price-based indicators are inadequate in capturing the market dynamism arising from real-world events such as social sentiments, political instability, or sudden economic shifts. With the rise of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) and data availability, there is a requirement for more efficient algorithms that can incorporate these external factors in trading strategies. DRL has shown potential in simulating real-world scenarios and in simplifying complex decision-making since DRL agents can automate the trading process i.e. executing trades in a manner comparable to human traders. They have shown reliable performance since they can update their policies based on risk and quantitative factors. In this paper, we propose a DRL approach based on partial and deep-infusion of sentimental analysis. It features distinct policy designs of actor-critic-based agents: only policy optimization ( A2C & PPO ) and policy optimization along with Q-learning principles ( DDPG, TD3 & SAC ). Our findings reveal, that the agents based on policy optimization combined with Q-learning, significantly and consistently demonstrate improved performance upon sentiment deep-infusion in profit maximization as well as risk-averse trading.

paragraphs.en: In 2024, India will remain the world’s fastest-growing major economy. According to the World Bank’s GDP ranking 2024 list India is the 5th largest economy, inevitably with rapid development, an increase in social media usage, the spread of the digital economy, and financial literacy more and more retail investors are investing their money in stock markets. Hence, the need to develop optimal trading strategies that are profitable and minimize risk is paramount. The stock market is a dynamic and rapidly changing environment, and many traditional trading strategies based on stochastic calculus, numerical analysis, and quadratic programming ( Harrison and Pliska, 1983 ) may prove to be suboptimal since they fall short in utilizing all the dynamically evolving relevant factors that influence the equities such as stocks.

paragraphs.en: Deep learning-based methods show potential in this scenario since they are capable of extracting relevant features from huge datasets. Supervised learning-based approaches to predict stock prices mainly follow two steps, that is, forecasting and decision-making ( Pahwa and Agarwal, 2019 ) . But such strategies may lead to suboptimal performance due to “ forecasting bottleneck ”. Reinforcement Learning (RL) solves this problem since it is based on “ learn by experience ” methodology, whereas supervised learning is based on “ learn by example ”. It shows excellent performance in stochastic environments such as the stock market due to its ability to make sequential decisions ( Lee, 2001 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于深度学习的方法在此场景中展现出潜力，因为它们能够从海量数据集中提取相关特征。 基于监督学习的股票价格预测方法主要遵循两个步骤，即预测和决策（Pahwa and Agarwal, 2019）。 但由于“预测瓶颈”，此类策略可能导致次优表现。 强化学习（RL）解决了这一问题，因为它基于“从经验中学习”的方法论，而监督学习则基于“从示例中学习”。 由于具备做出序贯决策的能力，它在股票市场等随机环境中展现出卓越的性能（Lee, 2001；Wu et al., 2023）。

paragraphs.en: However, the bottleneck of reinforcement learning approaches is its inefficiency in scaling with the huge amount of information processing required for real-world scenarios. In this scenario, deep reinforcement learning fits as a solution. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) uses agents or robots to develop trading strategies in complex scenarios involving numerous features. The agent mainly works by either optimizing its policy or the value function. The agents that we have used are mainly those that optimize policy and those that optimize policy and value function.

paragraphs.en: The stock price movement is highly volatile and is not solely based on quantitative features such as the performance metrics of a company and the technical indicators. Many important scenarios that impact the country’s fate such as elections, budget, etc. have seen significant movement in stock prices. Thus, considering quantitative features only in stochastic decision-making processes is painting only half a picture, it is necessary to include qualitative features as well such as the sentiment value.
paragraphs.zh: 股价走势高度波动，且并非仅基于诸如公司业绩指标和技术指标等量化特征。 许多影响国家命运的重要场景，例如选举、预算等，都曾引起股价的显著波动。 因此，在随机决策过程中仅考虑量化特征只反映了情况的一半，还必须纳入定性特征，例如情绪值。

paragraphs.en: Stock market prediction has been of interest to researchers for an extended time. The earlier studies utilized linear ( Cakra and Trisedya, 2015 ) and machine learning techniques ( Pai and Lin, 2005 ) to build predictive models. Over time various evolved techniques such as artificial neural networks ( Ticknor, 2013 ) were employed to predict stock prices, options prices, exchange rates, etc. Some techniques involved extracting qualitative information using text mining to predict the stock prices ( Oliveira et al., 2017 ; Hagenau et al., 2013 ) . Several works used natural language processing techniques to forecast financial instrument movement ( Yildirim et al., 2018 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 股市预测长期以来一直受到研究人员的关注。 早期的研究利用线性方法（Cakra and Trisedya, 2015）和机器学习技术（Pai and Lin, 2005）来构建预测模型。 随着时间推移，各种演化出的技术，例如人工神经网络（Ticknor, 2013），被用于预测股票价格、期权价格、汇率等。 一些技术涉及使用文本挖掘提取定性信息来预测股票价格（Oliveira et al., 2017；Hagenau et al., 2013）。 多项工作使用自然语言处理技术来预测金融工具的走势（Yildirim et al., 2018）。

paragraphs.en: In the deep learning landscape, the authors of ( Cao and Wang, 2019 ) proposed a modified CNN and time series analysis of financial data to build a forecasting model for stock prices. In a similar vein, in ( Sezer and Ozbayoglu, 2018 ) CNN is used on stock chart images to develop a financial trading model. Recurrent neural networks show excellent performance on time series data. They have also been employed in predictive stock trading, the authors of ( Huynh et al., 2017 ) used a Bidirectional GRU network and compared its performance with LSTM and GRU. Attention-based LSTM was another method proposed for stock prediction ( Cheng et al., 2018 ) .LSTM with optimization algorithms is explored by the author of ( Gülmez, 2023 ) . Reinforcement learning has an advantage in simulating real-life trading scenarios and faster and superior decision-making. There has been ongoing research in this direction establishing the effectiveness of RL-based models for stock prediction ( Lee, 2001 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) . Deep reinforcement learning combines the feature extraction capabilities of deep learning with real-world simulation and complex decision-making abilities of reinforcement learning. DRL-based models are capable of providing useful insights as well as planning and developing complex trading strategies ( Zou et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在深度学习领域，(Cao and Wang, 2019) 的作者提出了一种改进的卷积神经网络（CNN）并对金融数据进行时间序列分析，以构建股价预测模型。 类似地，(Sezer and Ozbayoglu, 2018) 将 CNN 应用于股票图表图像，以开发金融交易模型。 循环神经网络在时间序列数据上表现出优异的性能。 它们也被应用于预测性股票交易，(Huynh et al., 2017) 的作者使用了双向 GRU 网络，并将其性能与 LSTM 和 GRU 进行了比较。 基于注意力机制的 LSTM 是另一种被提出的股票预测方法 (Cheng et al., 2018)。(Gülmez, 2023) 的作者探讨了 LSTM 与优化算法的结合。 强化学习在模拟真实交易场景以及实现更快、更优的决策方面具有优势。 在这一方向上已有持续的研究，证明了基于强化学习的模型在股票预测方面的有效性 (Lee, 2001; Wu et al., 2023)。 深度强化学习将深度学习的特征提取能力与强化学习的真实场景模拟和复杂决策能力相结合。 基于 DRL 的模型能够提供有价值的洞见，并规划和制定复杂的交易策略 (Zou et al., 2024)。

sents.en: There has been ongoing research in this direction establishing the effectiveness of RL-based models for stock prediction ( Lee, 2001 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 在这一方向上已有持续的研究，证明了基于强化学习的模型在股票预测方面的有效性 (Lee, 2001; Wu et al., 2023)。

sents.en: Deep reinforcement learning combines the feature extraction capabilities of deep learning with real-world simulation and complex decision-making abilities of reinforcement learning.
sents.zh: 深度强化学习将深度学习的特征提取能力与强化学习的真实场景模拟和复杂决策能力相结合。

sents.en: DRL-based models are capable of providing useful insights as well as planning and developing complex trading strategies ( Zou et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 基于 DRL 的模型能够提供有价值的洞见，并规划和制定复杂的交易策略 (Zou et al., 2024)。

paragraphs.en: The existing work establishes the effectiveness of deep learning-based agents. Building upon this foundation we have further explored and compared the decision-making abilities of five distinct DRL agents which have unique policy designs, in the same market conditions. We further experimented with sentiment infusion, to analyze the trading behavior of these agents upon providing more context of the financial market.
paragraphs.zh: 现有工作确立了基于深度学习的智能体的有效性。 在此基础上，我们进一步探索并比较了五种具有独特策略设计的不同深度强化学习智能体在相同市场条件下的决策能力。 我们还进一步进行了情感注入实验，以分析这些智能体在获得更多金融市场背景信息后的交易行为。

sents.en: The existing work establishes the effectiveness of deep learning-based agents.

paragraphs.en: For the stock historical dataset, we selected 5 top Indian stocks by market capitalization: Reliance, Adani, Bharti Airtel, HDFC and ICICI, covering main financial sectors such as energy, telecommunication, banking. The main advantages of selecting stocks by market capitalization are, stocks with larger market capitalization tend to be more stable and less volatile compared to smaller-cap stocks.
paragraphs.zh: 对于股票历史数据集，我们选取了按市值排名前五的印度股票：Reliance、Adani、Bharti Airtel、HDFC 和 ICICI，涵盖了能源、电信、银行等主要金融行业。 按市值选股的主要优势在于，与大市值股票相比……市值较大的股票往往比小市值股票更稳定、波动性更小。

paragraphs.en: Larger companies often have more comprehensive and accurate financial data available. This can be advantageous for RL algorithms, as high-quality data is crucial for training models and making informed investment decisions. Large-cap stocks typically have a significant influence on the overall market. By focusing on these stocks, RL models can align more closely with broader market trends and indices.
paragraphs.zh: 较大的公司通常拥有更全面、更准确的财务数据。 这对强化学习算法是有利的，因为高质量的数据对于训练模型和做出明智的投资决策至关重要。 大盘股通常对整体市场具有重大影响力。 通过关注这些股票，强化学习模型可以与更广泛的市场趋势和指数更加一致。

paragraphs.en: The range of our financial dataset is 5.5 years from Jan 2019 to June 2024. We obtained the historical data of the selected stocks from Yahoo Finance. The features of historical stock data from Yahoo Finance are: Date, Ticker, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume & Day . We have also pre-processed out financial data by adding technical indicators, CBOE Volatility Index (VIX) and turbulence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们金融数据集的时间跨度为5.5年，从2019年1月到2024年6月。 我们从雅虎财经获取了所选股票的历史数据。 来自雅虎财经的历史股票数据的特征包括：日期（Date）、股票代码（Ticker）、开盘价（Open）、最高价（High）、最低价（Low）、收盘价（Close）、成交量（Volume）和天数（Day）。 我们还对金融数据进行了预处理，加入了技术指标、芝加哥期权交易所波动率指数（VIX）和湍流指标。

paragraphs.en: The technical indicators are: Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD), Bollinger Bands, Relative Strength Index (RSI-30), Commodity Channel Index (CCI-30), Directional Index (DX-30), 30-day Simple Moving Average (Close 30 SMA), 60-day Simple Moving Average (Close 60 SMA).

paragraphs.en: We build the corresponding financial news dataset for the prior selected stocks using Google’s RSS Feeds API. To obtain a broad context and reporting for the stocks we collected multiple news for the same stock at any given day among the timeline we had decided earlier ( 5 years).
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Google 的 RSS Feeds API 为先前选定的股票构建相应的金融新闻数据集。 为了获得广泛的背景信息和股票相关报道，我们在先前确定的时间线（5 年）内，针对同一股票在任意给定日期收集了多条新闻。

paragraphs.en: After scraping the headlines, we did a sentiment analysis of these headlines using FinBERT, (BERT for Financial Text Mining).
paragraphs.zh: 在抓取新闻标题后，我们使用 FinBERT（用于金融文本挖掘的 BERT）对这些标题进行了情感分析。

paragraphs.en: The authors of FinBERT ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , have used two financial corpuses to further pre-train the BERT model. They used TRC2-financial which consists of 46,143 documents with more than 29M words and nearly 400K sentences. The second dataset is Financial PhraseBank ( Malo et al., 2013 ) which consists of 4845 English sentences selected randomly from financial news found on LexisNexis database.
paragraphs.zh: FinBERT 的作者（Liu 等，2021）使用了两个金融语料库对 BERT 模型进行了进一步预训练。 他们使用了 TRC2-financial，该语料库包含 46,143 篇文档、超过 2900 万个词以及近 40 万个句子。 第二个数据集是 Financial PhraseBank（Malo 等，2013），它包含从 LexisNexis 数据库中的金融新闻里随机选取的 4845 个英文句子。

sents.en: The authors of FinBERT ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , have used two financial corpuses to further pre-train the BERT model.

sents.en: They used TRC2-financial which consists of 46,143 documents with more than 29M words and nearly 400K sentences.

sents.en: The second dataset is Financial PhraseBank ( Malo et al., 2013 ) which consists of 4845 English sentences selected randomly from financial news found on LexisNexis database.

paragraphs.en: FinBERT generates 3 normalized label scores for each headline i.e. positive, negative and neutral where ‘positive’ label is encoded as 1, ‘negative’ label as -1 and ‘neutral’ label as 0. We assigned the label with the highest score to corresponding news.
paragraphs.zh: FinBERT 为每条新闻标题生成 3 个归一化的标签分数，即正面、负面和中性，其中「正面」标签编码为 1，「负面」标签编码为 -1，「中性」标签编码为 0。 我们将得分最高的标签分配给相应的新闻。

paragraphs.en: To model this research problem, we have replicated the trading activity in market structure onto agent and environment based framework. The trading activity is primarily a Markov Decision Process (MDP), where an agent is an actor, taking the action by interacting with the dynamic environment.
paragraphs.zh: 为了对这一研究问题建模，我们将市场结构中的交易活动复制到一个基于智能体和环境的框架中。 交易活动本质上是一个马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其中智能体是行动者，通过与环境进行交互来执行动作。

paragraphs.en: Every trading activity by the DRL model is a series of Markov decisions. The Environment consists of the states, reward and metadata. The sequential decisions taken by the agents over a course of action are represented as a list of states and the associated rewards with each step. By continuous feedback from the dynamically changing environment, agents learn to trade better by policy optimization, which is a component of agents.
paragraphs.zh: DRL 模型的每一笔交易活动都是一系列马尔可夫决策。 环境由状态、奖励和元数据组成。 智能体在一系列行动过程中做出的顺序决策被表示为一个状态列表以及每一步相关的奖励。 通过来自动态变化环境的持续反馈，智能体通过策略优化学会更好地交易，策略优化是智能体的一个组成部分。

paragraphs.en: The actor-critic method is based on policy gradient and primarily has two neural networks, an actor and a critic. The actor determines the next action while getting post-action feedback about their impact from the critic network. This step is simplified further by employing an advantage function which acts as an estimator by minimizing variance and giving faster learning speed. The A2C is synchronous while A3C is asynchronous ( Haarnoja et al., 2018 ) . In A3C the parallel update step reduces the inter-dependence of actor-learner for one to finish before starting the other process.
paragraphs.zh: actor-critic（演员-评论家）方法基于策略梯度，主要包含两个神经网络：一个演员网络和一个评论家网络。 演员网络决定下一个动作，同时从评论家网络获得关于该动作影响的事后反馈。 通过引入优势函数可进一步简化这一步骤，它作为一种估计器，在降低方差的同时加快学习速度。 A2C 是同步的，而 A3C 是异步的（Haarnoja 等，2018）。 在 A3C 中，并行更新步骤减少了演员-学习器之间的相互依赖，即无需等待其中一个完成才能开始另一个过程。

paragraphs.en: This is an off-policy algorithm based on an actor-critic architecture but utilizes deterministic policy gradient theorem ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) . Here the advantage is generated by using a replay buffer which can store and sample experiences requiring less data and smoother learning. Instead of providing an action probability distribution, it simply suggests the exact action to take, hence the name “deterministic”. This algorithm also works on continuous action space ( Lillicrap et al., 2019 ; Haarnoja et al., 2018 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 这是一种基于行动者-评论家（actor-critic）架构的离线策略（off-policy）算法，但使用了确定性策略梯度定理（ Schulman 等， 2017 ）。 这里通过使用经验回放缓冲区来生成优势，该缓冲区可以存储并采样经验，从而所需数据更少、学习更平滑。 它并不给出动作的概率分布，而是直接给出要采取的确切动作，因此得名“确定性”。 该算法同样适用于连续动作空间（ Lillicrap 等， 2019 ； Haarnoja 等， 2018 ）。

paragraphs.en: SAC is an off-policy algorithm based on the actor-critic framework but with the concept of maximum entropy reinforcement learning ( Haarnoja et al., 2018 ) . The conventional RL prioritizes maximizing the expected return while SAC tweaks the policy to prioritize exploration as well as maximizing the returns but this improves the learning. So in non-standard Indian stock market conditions, SAC will potentially be able to balance between exploiting the working strategies as well as exploring novel trading strategies.
paragraphs.zh: SAC是一种基于actor-critic框架但引入最大熵强化学习概念的离策略（off-policy）算法（Haarnoja et al., 2018）。 传统强化学习优先最大化期望回报，而SAC在最大化回报的同时调整策略以优先探索，但这反而改善了学习效果。 因此，在非标准的印度股市环境下，SAC有望在利用有效策略与探索新颖交易策略之间取得平衡。

sents.zh: 而 DDPG 的表现则有显著改善，收益更高、风险调整后表现更好、回撤更小。

sents.en: TD3 experienced a decrease in performance by becoming less profitable, indicating that it could be more sensitive to how the infusion of sentiment impacted the reward structure.
sents.zh: TD3 的表现有所下降，盈利能力变弱，这表明它可能对情感注入如何影响奖励结构更为敏感。

paragraphs.en: The agents that optimize the policy as well as the Q-value (DDPG, SAC), become more stable upon deeper sentiment infusion except for TD3. Although TD3 is an improved version of DDPG but DDPG consistently showed improved performance upon deeper sentiment infusion whereas TD3 produced poor returns. This behavior arises from the more complex nature of TD3 to handle updates. TD3 uses double Q-learning to ensure conservative value updates. The infusion of sentiment might cause increased variability in the reward signal which caused TD3 to become overly conservative and under explore leading to suboptimal policies and hence drop in performance.
paragraphs.zh: 同时优化策略和Q值的智能体（DDPG、SAC）在更深度的情感注入下变得更加稳定，但TD3除外。 尽管TD3是DDPG的改进版本，但DDPG在更深度的情感注入下持续表现出性能提升，而TD3却产生了较差的回报。 这种行为源于TD3在处理更新方面更为复杂的特性。 TD3使用双重Q学习以确保保守的价值更新。 情感的注入可能导致奖励信号的变异性增加，这使TD3变得过于保守、探索不足，从而导致次优策略，进而造成性能下降。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we simulated the real-world trading of curated stocks via reinforcement learning agents that interacted with the dynamically changing market condition modeled as a reinforcement learning framework. We selected the actor-critic-based agents with distinct policy design specifically, A2C and PPO are based only on policy optimization, whereas DDPG, TD3 & SAC are based on policy optimization combined with Q-learning principles.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们通过强化学习智能体模拟精选股票的真实交易，这些智能体与被建模为强化学习框架的动态变化市场环境进行交互。 我们选择了基于演员-评论家、具有不同策略设计的智能体：具体而言，A2C 和 PPO 仅基于策略优化，而 DDPG、TD3 和 SAC 则基于策略优化与 Q 学习原理相结合。

paragraphs.en: We initially performed the trading operation without any qualitative features using only technical indicators. Introducing partial sentiment infusion improved the performance of all agents except PPO. Deeper sentiment infusion led to consistently improved performance of policy optimization and Q-learning-based agents (DDPG and SAC) while TD3 due to a more conservative approach to value estimation demonstrated decreased performance. Notably, DDPG consistently exhibited performance improvement with SAC also showing significant improvement and ranking just below DDPG.
paragraphs.zh: 我们最初仅使用技术指标进行了不具备任何定性特征的交易操作。 引入部分情感注入提升了除 PPO 之外所有智能体的性能。 更深入的情感注入使基于策略优化和 Q 学习的智能体（DDPG 和 SAC）性能持续提升，而 TD3 由于采用更为保守的价值估计方法，性能有所下降。 值得注意的是，DDPG 始终表现出性能提升，SAC 也显示出显著提升，排名仅次于 DDPG。

paragraphs.en: For further research, Explainable Reinforcement Learning (XRL) techniques ( Milani et al., 2024 ; Amitai et al., 2024 ) are recommended to demonstrate the impact of various features such as sentiment score and various technical indicators on the agent’s decision-making process.
